high_level_description: The image is a news headline from "Daily Excelsior" dated July 21, 2024. The headline reads: "Army deploys over 3500 more jawans, 500 para commandos." This indicates that the Indian Army has deployed an additional 3,500 soldiers (jawans) and 500 para commandos. The accompanying photograph shows a group of soldiers marching in formation. They are dressed in camouflage uniforms with maroon berets, which are characteristic of the Indian Army. Each soldier is equipped with a rifle and appears to be carrying additional gear,
